{{Short description|Finnish professor (1953–2023)}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=June 2024}}
'''Fjalar Finnäs''' (1953–2023)<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.osterbottenstidning.fi/Artikel/Visa/746227 |title=Fjalar Finnäs har gått bort |last=Häggström |first=Louise |date=29 December 2023 |website=[[Österbottens Tidning]] |language=sv |access-date=3 June 2024}}</ref> was a [[Finland|Finnish]] professor of [[demographics]] at the [[Åbo Akademi University]].<ref>{{cite web| url = https://svenska.yle.fi/artikel/2016/08/26/fjalar-finnas-har-koll-pa-finlandssvenskarna| title = Fjalar Finnäs har koll på finlandssvenskarna {{!}} Österbotten {{!}} svenska.yle.fi}} </ref> He focused on the demographics of the [[Swedish-speaking Finns]].<ref>*[http://www.abo.fi/student/Content/Document/document/12283 Page on Åbo Akademi website] {{Webarchive|url=https://archive.today/20120723155657/http://www.abo.fi/student/Content/Document/document/12283 |date=2012-07-23 }}</ref> His most recent research was in Ethno-Linguistic Exogamy and Divorce.<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Saarela|first1=Jan|last2=Finnäs|first2=Fjalar|date=2018-03-30|title=Ethno-Linguistic Exogamy and Divorce: Does Marital Duration Matter?|url=https://www.researchgate.net/publication/324118458|journal=Sociological Focus|volume=51|issue=4|pages=279–303|doi=10.1080/00380237.2018.1431506|s2cid=159032504}}</ref>

== Researches ==
* Jan 2014 – Sex composition of children, parental separation, and parity progression<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Fjalar_Finnaes|title=Fjalar Finnäs {{!}} PhD {{!}} Åbo Akademi University, Turku|website=ResearchGate|language=en|access-date=2020-01-20}}</ref>
* Feb 2014 – Transitions within and from ethno-linguistically mixed and endogamous first unions in Finland
* Feb 2014 – Infant mortality and ethnicity in an indigenous European population<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Saarela|first1=Jan|last2=Finnäs|first2=Fjalar|date=2014-02-27|title=Infant mortality and ethnicity in an indigenous European population: novel evidence from the Finnish population register|journal=Scientific Reports|volume=4|pages=4214|doi=10.1038/srep04214|doi-access=free|issn=2045-2322|pmc=5379437|pmid=24572973|bibcode=2014NatSR...4E4214S}}</ref>
* Sep 2015 – The Ethno-linguistic Community and Premature Death
* Aug 2017 – Divorce and parity progression following the death of a child<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://research.abo.fi/converis/portal/Person/516419?auxfun=&lang=en_GB|title=Fjalar Finnäs - CONVERIS Research Information System - Converis 5 Åbo Akademi University|website=research.abo.fi|access-date=2020-01-20}}{{Dead link|date=September 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }}</ref>
* Mar 2018 – Ethno-Linguistic Exogamy and Divorce
